document.abstract: This practice specifies a method of coding an auxiliary time address into the binary groups of SMPTE time and control codes, thus providing a second time address storage and storage location. — The dialect used provides auxiliary time address hours information conforming to the directory index 00 through 23 (decimal), as specified in ANSI/SMPTE 262M. It also conforms to the coding structure of the primary time code located in the time address portion of the time code word.
